title: HA WebSocket result of <ns>/family
description: The result field of the HA answer {id, type: result, success: true, result}: exactly the body of POST /api/integration/family – the hub's answer messages (ws/server/family_*, family_error or, for a child device, kids_request_state), 1–10, unchanged. Apps read result.messages[] like on the hub WebSocket (request_id echoed where the hub echoes it). Same shape as integration/family.response.json (kept identical by the integration). Also access_request_update, access_requests, access_request_state and access_request_error.
